segments.note: Free tier is enough: nothing is charged. TC-001 / TC-002 / TC-010 – TC-014 need the Demo page not yet dismissed; TC-014 (ticks 「Don’t show again」) goes last among them. Test videos from make-videos.ts in Movies/casebook-ve and Movies/VE test.

segments.note: Charged: each Enhance costs its CTA price; record the balance before and after and the Credit Details rows. TC-100 style offline cases use device-android.ts wifi. segments.note: Uses the tasks R1-e made. TC-265 – TC-267 time the task with waitfor's seconds. Judge 「Result」 over 「Original」 on the real-footage tasks (ve-real-*).
